messages.subject: Error in function SurveyReport
parts:
When I run the function SurveyReport I get an error warning "Error: Cannot read datetime format in c("2017-01-05 01:29:42", "2017-01-08 02:16:43", "2017-01-09 06:46:10",  . Output is all NA." 

I tried change date format in both recordTable and CTtable to make them uniform but doesn't work. What could have gone wrong?

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in function SurveyReport
parts:
Hi, 
the first issue is here is that the error message doesn't give the expected output, my bad. It should be 
"Error: Cannot read datetime format in recordTable[, recordDateTimeCol]. Output is all NA." 

It is fixed on github already (you can try installing from there) and will be part of the next version.

The reason for this error is that argument recordDateTimeFormat is specified wrongly, so camtrapR cannot interpret the date/time column of the records. If its not that or you're unsure please share the code and str() of the data. You can try specifying recordDateTimeFormat in lubridate format, it makes things easier (e.g. “ymd HMS” instead of “%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S”).
Best,
Jürgen

P.S. I changed the error message you got for future releases to the following (expected and actual will of course adapt to your data). Is that clearer?

Error: Cannot read datetime format in recordTable[, recordDateTimeCol]. Output is all NA.
expected:  %Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S
actual:    2009-04-21 00:40:00

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in function SurveyReport
parts:
Hi Yadav,
the error means that there are stations in the record table that are not in the camera trap table.
You can check via something like: 

sppRT$Station[!sppRT$Station %in% camtraps$Station]

I didn't test the line, but I guess it should return stations of sppRT that are not in camtraps$Station.
Usually it's just typos, or an extra white space somewhere.

It would probably be helpful if the error message tells you directly which stations don't match. I'll see that I incorporate that.
Best,
Jürgen

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in function SurveyReport
parts:
Hi Yadav,

yes, the record table takes its station IDs from the folder names. Folder names are either created manually or with the function createStationFolders(). 
If they are created manually, there can be accidental mismatches due to typos. This is why it is better to run the function createStationFolders() to automatically create the directory structure for storing images using the station / camera IDs in the camera trap table as input. That way, there can't be any mismatches in the station IDs between the camera trap table and the record table (because both are based on the same input: the camera trap table).

Or did you use createStationFolders() and still got these mismatches? That would be surprising and should not happen. In that case, would you please provide more details on the workflow leading up to this situation?

Best regards,
Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Re: Error in function SurveyReport
parts:
Hi,

str(CTtable ) shows data type of the problem columns as logical (meaning, TRUE / FALSE), which does not make sense for the Problem columns. And it is different form your setup / retrieval columns. Therefore the function complains that it can't read those columns. #

Seems to be a formatting issue with the columns of the CT table.

Cheers,

Jürgen
